advanced.intro: Protocol-specialised attacks: JWT, CORS, cache poisoning, HTTP smuggling, blind timing, GraphQL, WebSocket. Previously CLI-only — now available here.

advanced.zap_on: ZAP client available — attacks will route via ZAP proxy when supported
advanced.zap_off: No ZAP client — attacks will run with direct HTTP (still safe for read-only tests)
advanced.no_findings: No findings — either no targets matched, or all tests passed
